headline: Retirees Can Now Get 100 Percent Downside Protection in an ETF and Still Keep Stock Market Upside
summary: Structured notes have long offered this kind of downside protection, but retirees had to lock up capital and accept illiquidity to get it. A new breed of ETF changes that equation in a way most conservative investors have not yet considered.
